articles.title: Sekisui Chemical (TSE:4204) Looks Undervalued After Recent Share Price Softness
articles.summary: Sekisui Chemical (TSE:4204) has drawn fresh attention after recent share price softness, with the stock down about 4% over the past month and roughly 3% over the past 3 months. That recent softness sits within a mixed picture for Sekisui Chemical, with the 1-year total shareholder return down 6.43% even as the 3-year and 5-year total shareholder returns are up 29.14% and 59.91% respectively.
